study: cross-fitted outcome-adaptive per-arm C-TMLE with a parametric outcome

configuration.outcome_learner: ParametricOutcome: unpenalized logistic GLM on [A indicators, W, A x W], one fit per fold
configuration.treatment_learner: ParametricMechanism: per arm and fold, unpenalized logistic regression of 1{A = a} on the cubic in l = logit(clip(Qbar_k(a, W), 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6))
configuration.comparator: none: Python property evidence, no comparator
configuration.comparator_reason: drtmle's adapt_g reports the shipped curve, so no R program measures the corrected curve; the point estimate of the in-sample form agrees with the registered pipelines through test_parametric_learners.py
configuration.budget_rule: plan 13.6 (rev 3.1) expected budgets, each a multiple of 400; the study-wise rule of plan section 12 with G = 10 gated units, each sized to pass with probability >= 0.95 ** (1 / 10); crossfit_null and the primary phase are sized at 1,200 (at most 93 rejections pass in crossfit_null)

failure_bounds.applied: 0.01 in both phases: a cell may lose floor(0.01 R) replicates, and each clause is judged by its worst case over the lost values; one more lost replicate reads bound exceeded. A fit that raises, and an admitted fit whose stack status is not influence_curve, both count as failed replicates

configuration.calibration_efficiency_ratio: False: the noise control reads the SE-ratio rule, and no cell claims a ratio against an efficiency bound
configuration.declared_reading: A red calibration row is finite-sample only under the AGENT-BRIEF rule (its 99% SE-ratio interval contains 1, its coverage is consistent with 0.95, and diagnosis finds no defect). crossfit_1500__ate__shipped_curve__shrunken_se_control and repeats__ate__shipped_curve__shrunken_se_control must be red, that is, their SE-ratio intervals must leave the calibration band below. The harness publishes passed=True for such a control. If either control stays inside or straddles the band, its cell cannot see its term, the study is invalid, and it is redesigned before any reading. The coverage of psi_0 in the pseudo-true group, the sqrt(n) SD of the groups at n = 500 and n = 8,000, the per-draw spread of the repeated fits and the paired deficit of the generated-design pair are reported and gate nothing. The coverage of psi_0 is declared at 0.5646, 0.5646 and 0.2963 (psi0_coverage_expected).
configuration.publication_reading: gated: every row must pass, and a negative control passes by being red
configuration.family_mapping: the groups are interval_calibration cells named <label>__<estimand>__corrected, so the shared calibration verdict applies per estimand
